sections.section_heading: What is this MERN full stack program about?
sections.description:
This program is built for people who want to actually build things, not just watch someone else code. You'll start with the fundamentals of JavaScript and move through the full MERN stack, writing real code every week rather than sitting through slides.

By the end, you'll have built at least two complete applications: a smaller practice project early on, and a larger capstone you can show in interviews. Both go straight into your portfolio and GitHub profile.

Sessions are live and instructor-led, so you can ask questions as you go instead of getting stuck for hours. Recordings are shared afterwards in case you need to revisit a topic.

paragraphs: A little more clarity

Our fees are deliberately affordable and student-friendly compared to large bootcamps, and differ between the 1-month and 3-month tracks. Contact us, and we'll share the current fee sheet upfront — no hidden costs.

With structured, project-based training, you can build and deploy your first complete MERN application in 1 month and reach interview-ready depth: authentication, deployment, a multi-feature capstone in 3 months. Self-taught paths typically take far longer because there's no one to unblock you.

Yes. JavaScript-based full stack roles (React on the frontend, Node.js on the backend) remain among the most common developer openings at Technopark Trivandrum, Infopark Kochi, and Kerala startups, and the skills transfer directly to remote roles as well.
Entry-level full stack developers in Kerala typically start around ₹3–4 LPA, with candidates who have strong, deployed portfolio projects exactly what this course is built around progressing faster.

For the 3-month track, no, it starts from JavaScript fundamentals. For the 1-month crash program, basic programming familiarity helps because of the pace. Unsure which fits? Our free career session will tell you honestly.
The course includes an internship so you gain real experience before job applications.
Live online batches are available, and offline/classroom sessions are in Trivandrum. All sessions are instructor-led and interactive, never pre-recorded lectures.

Choose MERN if you want to specialise in web applications with one language (JavaScript) end-to-end. Choose our Python Full Stack & AI course if you also want AI/ML skills alongside web development. Both lead to full stack roles; the free career session can help you decide.

content.text: A little more clarity
Good questions.
What is the fee for the full stack developer course in Kerala?+

Our fees are deliberately affordable and student-friendly compared to large bootcamps, and differ between the 1-month and 3-month tracks. Contact us, and we'll share the current fee sheet upfront — no hidden costs.
How long does it take to become a full stack developer?+

With structured, project-based training, you can build and deploy your first complete MERN application in 1 month and reach interview-ready depth: authentication, deployment, a multi-feature capstone in 3 months. Self-taught paths typically take far longer because there's no one to unblock you.
Is the MERN stack still in demand in Kerala in 2026?+

Yes. JavaScript-based full stack roles (React on the frontend, Node.js on the backend) remain among the most common developer openings at Technopark Trivandrum, Infopark Kochi, and Kerala startups, and the skills transfer directly to remote roles as well.
What salary can a full stack developer expect in Kerala?+
Entry-level full stack developers in Kerala typically start around ₹3–4 LPA, with candidates who have strong, deployed portfolio projects exactly what this course is built around progressing faster.
Do I need coding experience to join?+

For the 3-month track, no, it starts from JavaScript fundamentals. For the 1-month crash program, basic programming familiarity helps because of the pace. Unsure which fits? Our free career session will tell you honestly.
Does the course include an internship?+
The course includes an internship so you gain real experience before job applications.
Is this course online or offline?+
Live online batches are available, and offline/classroom sessions are in Trivandrum. All sessions are instructor-led and interactive, never pre-recorded lectures.
MERN or Python full stack — which should I choose?+

Choose MERN if you want to specialise in web applications with one language (JavaScript) end-to-end. Choose our Python Full Stack & AI course if you also want AI/ML skills alongside web development. Both lead to full stack roles; the free career session can help you decide.
